description: This file defines a base Data Access Layer (DAL) class for database interactions in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for database connection, query building, and data retrieval, and manages external dependencies and class autoloading.

classes.name: MAX_Dal_Common
classes.description: A generic base class for data access, providing database connection, query building, and data retrieval functionalities, intended for inheritance by specific DAL classes.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate DAL classes based on model name.

methods.name: autoLoadClass
methods.description: Autoloads a class file for a given model name.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Generates class name based on table name.

methods.name: _get
methods.description: Builds and executes a database query based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getSqlListOrder
methods.description: Generates SQL ORDER BY clause based on list order and direction.

methods.name: getOrderDirection
methods.description: Returns SQL order direction ('ASC' or 'DESC') based on input.

methods.name: getOrderColumn
methods.description: Retrieves column name(s) for ordering based on list type.

methods.name: _getTablename
methods.description: Quotes and returns table name with prefix.

methods.name: _getTablenameUnquoted
methods.description: Returns unquoted table name with prefix.
